MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which greeting is the polite way to say hello to a teacher? (1 mark)
   A. 再见 zàijiàn
   B. 谢谢 xièxie
   C. 您好 nín hǎo
   D. 我叫 wǒ jiào

2. What does 米饭 (mǐfàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mango
   B. Banana
   C. Fruit (as a group)
   D. Cooked rice

3. Which Chinese word means "flat bread"? (1 mark)
   A. 香蕉 xiāngjiāo
   B. 晚饭 wǎnfàn
   C. 饼 bǐng
   D. 水 shuǐ

4. What does 你生日是几月几号? ask? (1 mark)
   A. Where do you live?
   B. What is your name?
   C. When is your birthday?
   D. What is your favourite food?

5. What does 苹果 (píngguǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Drinks
   B. Meat
   C. Apple
   D. Chicken (meat)

6. Which sentence means "Good morning!"? (1 mark)
   A. 早上好!
   B. 我叫小明。
   C. 再见!
   D. 谢谢!

7. How is 你好 nǐ hǎo really said? (1 mark)
   A. Like nì hǎo
   B. Like ní hǎo
   C. Like nǐ hào
   D. Like nī hǎo

8. Which sentence means "This is my father."? (1 mark)
   A. 那是我弟弟。
   B. 我家有五口人。
   C. 这是我爸爸。
   D. 那是我哥哥。

9. What does 二 (èr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Eight
   B. One
   C. Five
   D. Two

10. Which Chinese word means "hand"? (1 mark)
   A. 用 yòng
   B. 耳朵 ěrduo
   C. 手 shǒu
   D. 刷牙 shuāyá

11. What does 儿子 (érzi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Is, am, are
   B. Home, family
   C. Son
   D. Older brother

12. What does 门 (mén) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bedroom
   B. Door
   C. Above
   D. Left side

13. Which stroke goes from top to bottom? (1 mark)
   A. 竖 shù
   B. 横 héng
   C. 提 tí
   D. 捺 nà

14. Which word is pronounced yǐnliào? (1 mark)
   A. 鸡肉
   B. 饼
   C. 饮料
   D. 晚饭

15. What does 九 (jiǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Eight
   C. Two
   D. Nine

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give two habits for keeping your body clean. (2 marks)

17. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The window is above the sofa." (3 marks)

18. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 天 and 老师. (2 marks)

19. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: xièxie! (2 marks)

20. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 九 and 号. (2 marks)

21. Give the Chinese for mosque and church with pinyin. (2 marks)

22. Tell how to tell 大 dà from 太 tài by looking. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — 您好 nín hǎo
   您 is the polite form of you.

2. D — Cooked rice
   米饭 (mǐfàn) means cooked rice.

3. C — 饼 bǐng
   饼 (bǐng) means flat bread.

4. C — When is your birthday?
   月 is month and 号 is the date.

5. C — Apple
   苹果 (píngguǒ) means apple.

6. A — 早上好!
   早上好! (zǎoshang hǎo!) means "Good morning!".

7. B — Like ní hǎo
   Two third tones together: the first changes to the second tone.

8. C — 这是我爸爸。
   这是我爸爸。 (zhè shì wǒ bàba.) means "This is my father.".

9. D — Two
   二 (èr) means two.

10. C — 手 shǒu
   手 (shǒu) means hand.

11. C — Son
   儿子 (érzi) means son.

12. B — Door
   门 (mén) means door.

13. A — 竖 shù
   竖 is the vertical stroke.

14. C — 饮料
   饮料 is pronounced yǐnliào and means drinks.

15. D — Nine
   九 (jiǔ) means nine.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wash your hands with soap (洗手), brush your teeth (刷牙), bathe often, wear clean clothes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: 窗户在沙发上面。 chuānghu zài shāfā shàngmiàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: 天: tiān, sky, day. 老师: lǎoshī, teacher.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Thank you!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: 九: jiǔ, nine. 号: hào, date (day of the month).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì and 教堂 jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: 太 has an extra dot at the bottom right.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the dot and 1 mark for naming the two characters correctly.
